No stray `bookmarks.json` was created, and tests pass cleanly (6/6).

I built `bm.js` with `add`, `list --tag`, and `rm` commands storing data as JSON with a persistent `nextId` counter (so ids are never reused even after deletion), reading `BM_FILE` or defaulting to `bookmarks.json`. Tests in `test/bm.test.js` spawn the CLI against temp files and cover add/list ordering, tag filtering, deletion with id non-reuse, and error exit codes for bad input.

One formatting note: the spec's `<id> <url> [tags]` uses the same bracket convention as `<url> [tags...]` in the `add` usage, so I rendered tags as plain space-separated values (no literal brackets) — let me know if you wanted literal `[tag1, tag2]` output instead.
